{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check how many have sample_seq > 1 (i.e., re-tested)
df_retest = df[df["sample_seq"] > 1]
print(f'Number of re-tested patients: {df_retest["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check for -999 in baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df["biomarker_baseline"].eq(-999).sum()}')"}
